note: Wrong principle: constant-acceleration equations under a force that varies with time.
problem: A 2.0 kg block starts from rest on a frictionless surface. A horizontal force F = 6t N (t in seconds) acts on it. Find its speed at t = 3.0 s.

attempt.text:
At t = 3 s, F = 18 N
a = F/m = 18/2 = 9 m/s²
v = u + at = 0 + 9 × 3
v = 27 m/s
